_comment: Every number that turns a model score into a screening decision lives here. Reasoning: docs/risk_policy.md. The decision threshold itself comes from each model's model_card.json.

recommendations.low: No signs detected. Recommend routine screening at the next scheduled visit.
recommendations.medium: Borderline result. The case is sent to a specialist for review; consider a retake if the image was poor.
recommendations.high: Signs detected. Refer the patient to an eye specialist.

recommendations.low: No signs of diabetic retinopathy detected. Recommend routine annual diabetic eye screening.
recommendations.medium: Borderline diabetic retinopathy score. Sent for specialist review.
recommendations.high: Signs of diabetic retinopathy detected. Refer to an eye specialist.
